mapper.select:
select r.request_seq, r.expert_seq, r.category_seq, c.name as category_name, r.address, to_char(r.wish_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as wish_date, r.budget, r.quote_count, to_char(r.quote_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as quote_deadline, to_char(r.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as regdate from tbl_request r join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = r.category_seq where r.status = 'OPEN' and r.hidden = 'N' and r.quote_deadline > sysdate
and r.expert_seq = #{expertSeq}
and r.expert_seq is null and r.category_seq in (select category_seq from tbl_talent where expert_seq = #{expertSeq} and enabled = 'Y') and r.request_seq not in (select request_seq from tbl_quote where expert_seq = #{expertSeq})
order by r.request_seq desc

select r.request_seq, r.expert_seq, r.category_seq, c.name as category_name, r.address, to_char(r.wish_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as wish_date, r.budget, r.status, r.quote_count, to_char(r.quote_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as quote_deadline, to_char(r.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, floor((r.quote_deadline - sysdate) * 24 * 60) as remain_minutes from tbl_request r join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = r.category_seq where r.request_seq = #{requestSeq} and r.hidden = 'N' and (r.expert_seq = #{expertSeq} or r.request_seq in (select request_seq from tbl_quote where expert_seq = #{expertSeq}) or (r.expert_seq is null and r.status = 'OPEN' and r.quote_deadline > sysdate and r.category_seq in (select category_seq from tbl_talent where expert_seq = #{expertSeq} and enabled = 'Y')))

select q.quote_seq, q.request_seq, q.expert_seq, q.price, q.work_days, q.content, q.status, to_char(q.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, (select max(t.trade_seq) from tbl_trade t where t.quote_seq = q.quote_seq) as trade_seq from tbl_quote q where q.request_seq = #{requestSeq} and q.expert_seq = #{expertSeq}
select count(*) from tbl_member m join tbl_expert_profile p on p.expert_seq = m.member_seq where m.member_seq = #{expertSeq} and m.role = 'ROLE_EXPERT' and m.enabled = 'Y' and p.hidden = 'N'
mapper.update: update tbl_request set quote_count = quote_count + 1, status = case when expert_seq is not null or quote_count + 1 >= 5 then 'CLOSED' else status end, select_deadline = case when expert_seq is not null or quote_count + 1 >= 5 then sysdate + 7 else select_deadline end where request_seq = #{requestSeq} and status = 'OPEN' and hidden = 'N' and quote_deadline > sysdate and quote_count < 5 and (expert_seq = #{expertSeq} or (expert_seq is null and category_seq in (select category_seq from tbl_talent where expert_seq = #{expertSeq} and enabled = 'Y')))
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_quote (quote_seq, request_seq, expert_seq, price, work_days, content) values (seq_quote.nextval, #{requestSeq}, #{expertSeq}, #{price}, #{workDays}, #{content})
mapper.select: select q.quote_seq, q.request_seq, q.price, q.work_days, q.status, to_char(q.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, c.name as category_name, r.address, r.status as request_status, case when r.expert_seq is null then 'N' else 'Y' end as designated from tbl_quote q join tbl_request r on r.request_seq = q.request_seq join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = r.category_seq where q.expert_seq = #{expertSeq} order by q.quote_seq desc
